test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Access Cookie Options from Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' link to open cookie options
And then check that the cookie options or privacy policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Close Cookie Banner on Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click button with id 'cookie-chiudi' to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Scopri il conto' from Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click 'Scopri il conto' link to view current account comparison
And then check that the current account comparison page is displayed

test_case_name: Initiate Online Investment from Investment Fund Page (Main CTA)

intents.intent: Click 'INIZIA A INVESTIRE ONLINE' link to start online investment process
And then check that the online investment initiation process is started or relevant modal/page is displayed

test_case_name: Initiate Online Investment from Investment Fund Page (Sticky CTA)

intents.intent: Click 'INIZIA A INVESTIRE' link to start online investment process from sticky CTA
And then check that the online investment initiation process is started or relevant modal/page is displayed

test_case_name: Access Investment Services Contract Information from Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click 'SCOPRI COME' link to view investment services contract information
And then check that the investment services contract information page is displayed

test_case_name: Search for Information on Investment Fund Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Type $name into input with placeholder 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?'
Click button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Reset Search Field on Investment Fund Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click button with class 'btn-reset-search' to clear the search field
And then check that the search input field is empty

test_case_name: Search for Information on Investment Fund Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Type $name into input with placeholder 'Cerca'
Click button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Access Client Login from Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click 'Accesso clienti' button to open the client login form
And then check that the client login form is displayed

test_case_name: Access Guest Login on Investment Fund Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'ENTRA' button to open the guest login form (desktop)
And then check that the guest login form is displayed

test_case_name: Access Guest Login on Investment Fund Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'ENTRA' button to open the guest login form (mobile)
And then check that the guest login form is displayed

test_case_name: Access Password Recovery from Investment Fund Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Recupera Password' link to start password recovery (desktop)
And then check that the password recovery process is initiated or the relevant page is displayed

test_case_name: Access Password Recovery from Investment Fund Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'Recupera password' link to start password recovery (mobile)
And then check that the password recovery process is initiated or the relevant page is displayed

test_case_name: Access Registration from Investment Fund Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Registrati' link to start the registration process (desktop)
And then check that the registration form or process is displayed

test_case_name: Access Registration from Investment Fund Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'REGISTRATI' button to start the registration process (mobile)
And then check that the registration form or process is displayed

test_case_name: Enable 'Mantieni L'accesso' Option on Investment Fund Page

intents.intent: Click checkbox labeled 'Mantieni L'accesso' to enable keep me logged in option
And then check that the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox is selected
